title: Typing information versus language and motor shortcuts
scientific_question: How much observed-key decoding performance remains under matched timing, ocular, pre/post-window, neural-shuffle and language controls on held-person/template support, and how does case-local assistance change it?
primary_outputs: Mapped observed positive-duration keypress classes and paired per-person CER contrasts. Null or unfavorable contrasts are valid outcomes; prose agreement with a favored mechanism is not a label.

data_manifest.size_category: 100GB–1TB per dataset card; no measured full-storage total

recording_contract.labels: MAT logs with key/RSVP events,Time,Keycode,Pressed,stim,trial_id; derived Keystroke,Word,Sentence events
recording_contract.time_alignment: Loader aligns recording triggers to behavioral logs, including dynamic time warping of ambiguous MEG inter-event intervals; exclusions and missing matches must be recorded.
recording_contract.biological_ids: Explicit warning: different MEG subject numbers can be same person; official correction logic/spreadsheet needed before splitting. EEG test fixture20subjects is not proof of final included cohort.
recording_contract.evidence: Parent-fetched HF API metadata/tree inspected locally; pinned loader text independently inspected; license fetched directly

missing_or_unverified: This specification does not establish a local public/private packet, payload equality or an executed task adapter.

inputs: Each key has 25 nonoverlapping 20-sample means from its declared 500-ms 1000-Hz source window: NEURAL [-0.2,0.3), PRE [-0.7,-0.2), POST [0.3,0.8) seconds.
Separate EOG, training-shuffle and timing-only views; timing uses key duration, preceding onset interval and first-key indicator.
Case-scoped opaque training groups and labels, sentence/key count and ordering, declared physical channel metadata; no target-person calibration.
forbidden_inputs: Query labels, intended sentence text, raw target hashes and source subject/template/session IDs.
Other case/arm/mode results, reference outputs, external corpora/LM APIs or evaluator feedback.
Query-fitted normalization, feature masks, weights or caches after the fresh final-fit reset.
allowed_inputs.case_identity: 78 symbolic held-person/template cases (38 MEG,40 EEG), with private operator bijection to authentic membership still required.
allowed_inputs.split: Each query is one held alias-resolved person and template fold; training uses other same-modality people and opposite fold. Every selected sentence from both folds contributes once. Template similarity independence beyond specified grouping is not established.
allowed_inputs.coverage: Declared full scope: 78 cases × six arms × two modes = 936 candidate episodes, 1,794 scoring contexts and 164 descriptive contrasts. Metadata declares 143 timelines/329 assets; these counts are not validated native ingestion.

biological_unit: Person within modality; 19 MEG and 20 EEG slots are declared source metadata, not 39 proven independent participants.
case_definition: One modality-local held-person × template-fold case; six information arms and two access modes are nested conditions.

split.policy: Each query is one held alias-resolved person and template fold; training uses other same-modality people and opposite fold. Every selected sentence from both folds contributes once. Template similarity independence beyond specified grouping is not established.
split.coverage: Declared full scope: 78 cases × six arms × two modes = 936 candidate episodes, 1,794 scoring contexts and 164 descriptive contrasts. Metadata declares 143 timelines/329 assets; these counts are not validated native ingestion.

reference.role: Official V1 neural typing-decoder source, loader and metrics; no execution or full final-language-model result claim.

controls: Known press alignment, sentence boundary and key-count assistance must be disclosed.
MEG EOG schema unresolved; zero-padding or substituted channels cannot satisfy the intended control.
No pooled cross-modal sample size; shared templates/training constrain inferential independence.
No physiological timing claim from retrospective window comparisons.

direct_observation.representation: A fixed neural observation packet with channel/time/coordinate units and the same declared calibration support, answered without execution.
direct_observation.boundary: No evaluator targets, source-label lookup, other-case memory or model/numerical tools; a direct response is evaluated separately from programme results.
missing: Authentic complete observation presentation and no-tools response collection have not been delivered.

typed_viewer.representation: Proposed typed navigation over the permitted neural observation, with units and calibration examples.
typed_viewer.boundary: Only rendered allowed observations; no raw target arrays or unrestricted filesystem/code access. A plot alone does not establish viewer execution.
missing: Task-specific renderer/action API, complete case collection and restrictive transport are absent.

tool_assisted.representation: Case-local numerical/model-assisted investigation under a fixed observation and compute entitlement.
tool_assisted.boundary: Current query inspection may inform an allowed proposal; fit/selection remains training-only and evaluator outcomes are inaccessible. Fresh case state is required.
missing: Authentic inputs, bounded participant execution and reference competence remain unqualified.

frozen_program.representation: Precommitted source, fitting/adaptation recipe and complete prediction output contract.
frozen_program.boundary: Freeze before query access; equal declared calibration and no post-query selection from evaluator feedback. Programme success does not measure unaided interpretation.
missing: Exact environment, source/data joins and complete execution qualification are outstanding.

primary.name: NEURAL person-macro sentence CER, separately by modality and access mode
primary.aggregation: Pool all sentence CERs across both folds within each person, then equal persons separately for MEG and EEG. No single pooled primary scalar.
primary.rationale: Retains direct behavioral prediction quality; an agent cannot increase its reward by degrading its own timing or ocular comparator.

secondary: All 164 signed paired descriptive contrasts and modality-specific reference comparisons.
Raw argmax and separately fixed LM0.5 sequence outputs; no prose-quality numerical score.
Full failure, fit and resource census; complete all-person support is required.

comparators.name: Fixed source-adapted neural references R0/R2
comparators.inputs: Same case/arm training and query geometry, with training-only fitting.
comparators.procedure: Evaluator-owned reference sources and separate fitting/inference lineage; competence remains unqualified.

comparators.name: Language-only R1 and fixed LM0.5
comparators.inputs: Training-only class transition counts with Laplace smoothing; no query targets.
comparators.procedure: Independent scoring uses deterministic argmax or fixed transition/emission decoding; no external LM access.

comparators.name: Timing/EOG/window/shuffle controls
comparators.inputs: Exact six views from identical selected observations.
comparators.procedure: Complete paired comparisons at same modality/person support; controls are mandatory and negative results retained.

nuisance_controls: Known press alignment, sentence boundary and key-count assistance must be disclosed.
MEG EOG schema unresolved; zero-padding or substituted channels cannot satisfy the intended control.
No pooled cross-modal sample size; shared templates/training constrain inferential independence.
No physiological timing claim from retrospective window comparisons.
evaluation.uncertainty: Only descriptive person SE and paired difference SE are delivered. Shared training/templates and unresolved cross-modal pairing preclude treating those as calibrated confidence intervals or p-values.
evaluation.failure_policy: Exact n_keys × 29 finite simplex outputs per sentence; missing/duplicate/extra rows, incomplete people/folds or failed independent scoring make the affected/full comparison unavailable, never available-case averaging.

resources.basis: Planning estimate only; reuse author processed inputs first. Training/runtime/storage not measured for this task.
